title: Reflect research horizon
description: A wide half-disc of violet light stands on a full-width horizon hairline with a glowing round emblem sitting on the line; under it a centred badge, gradient heading and one-line lead, then two centred items (line icon, ink title, muted text) split by a hairline. The disc fades in as it enters the window. On phones the disc is cropped by the screen edges and the items stack between hairlines.
notes: media is the 890px half disc (a radar illustration in the original), emblem the 80px mark on the horizon; empty, a glow wash and a violet disc
name: reflect-research
